issues.description: The problem statement requires a Lecture constructor that initializes five attributes in a specific order (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), but the template's Lecture.java provides a constructor with only three parameters (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). The solution implements the five-parameter constructor. This mismatch in constructor parameters is structural and will prevent students from implementing the constructor as specified in the exercise and following the UML order.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the constructor signature in the template Lecture.java to include all five parameters in the UML-specified order: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) and initialize the corresponding attributes in the constructor body. This aligns the template with the problem description and the solution reference.
